transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the Friday rail transfer plan. We have four containers — C-1 through C-4 — all inspected and accepted by the rail carrier. The shipment includes battery modules, packaged lubricants, clinic coolers, and boxed repair parts. Loading starts at 0800 and the carrier accepts the completed load at 1600. Before I sign off on the final container plan, I need each of you to walk me through your category, which container you're assigning it to, and any handling controls we need in place. Who wants to start?
